I5.quote: This replication dataset gathers experimental measurements evaluating the performance of pristine metal-organic frameworks (MOFs) and MOF/carbon hybrids as cryo-adsorbents to mitigate boil-off (BO) losses in liquid hydrogen (LH2) systems operating below 20 K.

notes: The document is a data-repository README (Recherche Data Gouv, doi 10.57745/FCV2R0) plus its CSV data files (si1), the replication dataset for the article 10.1016/j.cej.2026.173683; it carries data, so not_primary was not applied. I1: the H2 measurement method (volumetric or gravimetric) is not named anywhere, but the files are gas-phase H2 adsorption/desorption isotherms (quantity adsorbed in cm3 g-1 STP or mmol/g vs pressure), not TPD, electrochemistry or computation, so I1 was judged met. I2 decides the code: sorbents are MIL-100(Fe), MIL-101(Cr), MOF-5 and their hybrids with 0.5 wt% carbon quantum dots, 1 wt% GO or 1 wt% exfoliated graphite; the majority component is the MOF in every sample, and protocol section 3 excludes MOFs. I4: the only surface areas are cumulative surface areas (S cum, m2 g-1) from the PSD files; no BET value is given. duplicate_data: the README calls itself 'Replication Data' with 'DOI Reference: 10.1016/j.cej.2026.173683' but does not state that the values were published before; in any case not_carbon precedes it. Not retracted (record flag false; no retraction notice).
